name: courses
description: Courses taught over several sessions, online or in person, to one person or many.

languages.description: Languages it is offered in, as BCP 47 tags such as en or es.

sessions.description: How many sessions the offer includes.

howDealsGo: A course can be one escrow, or several, one per part, so the student pays as it goes. Done is each part taught as described, and the student releases then. A timer to the teacher, set past each part, pays for parts taught if the student goes quiet. Before paying, read what each session covers.
